pick_hint: Three classics. Your best results are remembered.
mines_blurb: Clear the field without setting off a mine.
mines_won_body: Every safe cell is open, in %s.
mines_lost_body: The flags that were wrong are crossed out.
solitaire_blurb: Build each suit up from the ace to the king.
solitaire_hint: Click a card to move it. Right-click one to pick it up, then click where it goes.
solitaire_won_body: All four suits are home, in %s and %s moves.
snake_blurb: Eat, grow, and stay clear of the walls and your own tail.
snake_ready_body: Steer with the arrow keys or W A S D. Space or P pauses.
snake_paused_body: Press Space or P to carry on.
snake_over_body: You scored %s. Press Enter to play again.
